name: vantage
description: A prediction market built around resolution, settled by GenLayer Intelligent Contract consensus.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint:contracts: genvm-lint check contracts/vantage_charter.py && genvm-lint check contracts/vantage_market.py
scripts.test: npm run lint:contracts && npm run test:contracts
